method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Nasdaq sinks about 4% as AI rout, fresh Trump tariffs spook Wall St
Equities.reason: Large intraday Nasdaq drop tied to AI-sector rout and tariff shock — clear market-moving, risk-off signal for equities (tech-led). High relevance due to magnitude and broad index impact.

Equities.title: U.S. proposes new tariffs on 14 trading partners, including China and the EU
Equities.summary: The new levies seek to counter foreign trade practices deemed unfair, discriminatory or burdensome to U.S. commerce.
Equities.reason: Major trade-policy move that raises geopolitical and supply-chain risk for multinational equities and heightens market uncertainty — negative for risk sentiment and global earnings visibility.

Equities.title: Volatility-weary investors side swiped as tariff mayhem adds to tech pain
Equities.reason: Synthesis piece linking tariffs to renewed tech selling and higher volatility — reinforces the dominant risk-off narrative and reduced appetite for speculative/AI names.

Equities.title: Nvidia halts chip shipments to south-east Asia
Equities.summary: Move comes as US steps up export controls to prevent Chinese access to AI computing power
Equities.reason: Export-control escalation is a concrete supply/market-access shock for semiconductors and AI infrastructure suppliers — negative for semiconductor equities and an upside risk to volatility.

Equities.title: S&P warns Nvidia credit rating could be cut over 'rising' management and governance risk
Equities.summary: S&P Global Ratings said Nvidia's credit rating could be cut by one notch as it flagged "rising" management and governance risk at the chipmaker.
Equities.reason: Explicit credit-rating risk at the largest AI/semiconductor company amplifies governance concerns and could materially affect sector valuations and index performance — high relevance.

Equities.title: Jensen Huang, Trump and the 11 Days That Rocked Nvidia
Equities.reason: Deep-dive on the leadership/governance saga at Nvidia — reinforces uncertainty around the firm's management and the fragility of the AI leadership narrative, weighing on tech investor confidence.

Equities.title: CoreWeave’s Banks to Sell $4.5 Billion Meta-Tied Loan Next Week
Equities.reason: Forced sale of large AI-infrastructure loan shows stress in funding for AI plays and potential credit/contagion risk into tech-related financings — negative for risk assets and sector financing dynamics.

Equities.title: CME E-Mini Options Briefly Paused During Chaotic Opening Session
Equities.reason: Market-structure interruption during a volatile session underscores execution/risk-management stresses — modest negative for market liquidity and investor confidence.

Equities.title: Stocks rally in Asia, US tariffs not as dire as feared
Equities.reason: Regional rebound suggests dip-buying and partial resilience to tariff headlines; presents a short-term stabilising counterpoint to US tech-led weakness (lower relevance than direct selloff news).

Equities.title: Stocks, Nasdaq Futures Climb as AI Trade Rebounds: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Intraday rebound/dip-buying in AI names — indicates potential short-term mean-reversion but does not negate the broader regime of elevated volatility and headline risk.

Equities.title: Software stocks spared in tech rout as AI narrative shifts
Equities.summary: Semiconductor and software shares now neck-and-neck in 2026 as investors think again about the technology’s winners and losers
Equities.reason: Important sector rotation signal: investors re-weighting from semiconductors toward software winners in the AI ecosystem — positive for software/logic but part of a larger risk-off backdrop for semis.

Equities.title: Stocks Finish Lower After Wild Session
Equities.reason: Market wrap showing equities ending lower after volatile trading — supports the broader equity-risk-off narrative and illustrates lingering instability in market internals.

Rates.title: Fed’s preferred inflation gauge accelerated to 3.8% in October, raising the 2027 stakes for the central bank
Rates.summary: The personal consumption expenditures price index was expected to show an annual inflation rate of 3.8% in October, according to the Dow Jones consensus.
Rates.reason: PCE at 3.8% is a materially hotter inflation signal for the Fed’s preferred gauge — increases odds of further tightening / higher-for-longer rates -> negative for bond prices (yields up). High relevance given direct Fed policy transmission.

Rates.title: Fed says inflation hasn’t gotten any better ahead of key December vote on rates
Rates.reason: Headline frames inflation as not improving ahead of a crucial Fed decision — reinforces hawkish pricing and upside pressure on US yields; moderately high relevance as a policy-timing signal.

Rates.title: Dollar steady as sliding yields temper safe-haven bid
Rates.reason: Explicit mention of sliding yields implies a bond rally (yields down) which is supportive for bond prices. Acts as a near-term counter-signal to hawkish inflation print; relevance modest.

Rates.title: BoJ’s Tamura says must keep raising rates, as long as underlying inflation is around 2%
Rates.summary: Bank of Japan (BoJ) board member Naoki Tamura said on Thursday that the central bank must keep raising interest rates regardless of upside and downside price risks, as long as underlying inflation is around 2% and financial conditions remain accommodative.
Rates.reason: Clear BoJ guidance for further rate increases points to higher JGB yields and tighter global rates via policy convergence; relevant for global rates pricing, particularly Asia/Japan.

Rates.title: South Korea upgrades growth forecast, raises benchmark rates to highest in two years
Rates.summary: The central bank raised rates by 25 basis points to 3.25% for its final meeting of the year, in line with expectations from economists.
Rates.reason: A concrete 25bp hike directly lifts local yields and contributes to regional tightening — negative for bond prices in Korea and a modest influence on regional rates.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, October 27-28, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, October 27-28, 2026
Rates.reason: FOMC minutes are a high-relevance policy read; given contemporaneous hot inflation prints, the minutes likely reinforce a hawkish policy path and support higher yields — significant for rates markets.

Rates.title: BoJ’s Tamura: Focus shifts to preventing inflation overshoot and maintaining stability
Rates.summary: Bank of Japan (BoJ) board member Naoki Tamura said on Thursday that the central bank has shifted its focus from achieving 2% inflation to preventing an overshoot and maintaining stability.
Rates.reason: Related BoJ commentary that emphasizes avoiding inflation overshoot — still consistent with tighter policy but a more cautious framing; lower relevance than explicit rate-raising comments.

Rates.title: Emerging Asia’s Best Bond Rally Seen Extending in Philippines
Rates.reason: Headline indicates ongoing bond rally in the Philippines (yields down) — a regional pockets-of-rally signal that offsets some tightening narrative; modest relevance for Asia rates.

FX.title: British Pound steadies above 1.3100 as BoE policymakers leave December hike on the table
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair flatlines near 1.3120 during the early Asian trading hours on Thursday. Traders continue to assess hawkish comments from Bank of England (BoE) policymakers and hot US inflation data. The US markets will be closed on Thursday for Thanksgiving.
FX.reason: BoE hawkish signalling (rate-hike still on the table) is supportive for GBP vs USD. Hot US inflation and holiday liquidity are present but the dominant FX transmission is GBP-support from BoE comments, so net GBP-positive.

FX.title: Pound heads into BoE stability report flat after rate hearing
FX.summary: Three of the four Bank of England (BoE) rate-setters before Parliament's Treasury Committee leaned toward higher rates on Wednesday, and the Pound fell anyway. GBP/USD dropped from above 1.3100 to near 1.3050 around the US data and the hearing, then returned t
FX.reason: BoE officials’ hawkish leanings are supportive for sterling, but market reaction has been mixed (GBP fell then recovered). Signals are GBP-positive but ambiguous — moderate relevance.

FX.title: ECB meeting accounts are next for a Euro off its 19-month low
FX.summary: European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council member Kocher said market pricing for a December rate hike isn't unreasonable, and the Euro didn't move on it. EUR/USD fell below 1.0950 before the US data, held there through the releases, and has since risen to j
FX.reason: ECB commentary that markets may reasonably price a December hike is supportive for EUR vs USD. The euro remains fragile from its recent lows, so this is a moderate EUR-positive fundamental driver.

FX.title: Euro flat lines below 1.1000 vs USD; looks to ECB accounts for some impetus
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair consolidates around the 1.0970 region during the Asian session on Thursday, stalling a modest recovery from its lowest level since April 2025, touched earlier this week.
FX.reason: EUR is stabilising but range-bound beneath 1.10; ECB accounts are the near-term catalyst. This is a low-to-moderate EUR-positive technical/fundamental pause story.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index rebounds to near 103.85 as AI trade recovery extends
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) strives to regain ground on Thursday after a two-day corrective move. As of writing, the US Dollar Index (DXY), which gauges the Greenback’s value against six major currencies, is up 0.13% to near 103.85. The DXY attracts bids after revisit
FX.reason: DXY rebound signals broad USD strength (driven by AI trade/recovery flows). USD strength is the dominant cross-market FX impulse and is USD-negative from the FX asset-holder perspective.

FX.title: Japanese Yen holds gains as BoJ policymaker signals chance of faster-pace rate hikes
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair trades with mild losses around 159.20 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) strengthens against the US Dollar (USD) on hawkish comments from Bank of Japan (BoJ) policymakers and intervention fears.
FX.reason: Hawkish BoJ signals and intervention fears are driving JPY strength vs USD (USD/JPY down). This is a clear, market-relevant JPY-positive narrative with potential for larger FX flow impact.

FX.title: Japanese Yen edges higher on hawkish BoJ; modest USD uptick caps upside
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair attracts fresh sellers during the Asian session on Thursday, sliding to the 159.00 mark in the last hour, though it lacks follow-through. Spot prices remain confined in a familiar range, warranting some caution before placing aggressive direct
FX.reason: Additional confirmation of BoJ-driven JPY strength, but the piece notes limited follow-through — moderate relevance as a reinforcing, range-bound JPY-positive signal.

FX.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Holds gains above 0.6600, but broader trend stays bearish under 100-day SMA
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair gathers strength to near 0.6635 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. Hotter-than-expected Australian inflation data provide some support to the Australian Dollar (AUD) against the US Dollar (USD). The US markets will be closed
FX.reason: Australian inflation surprise provides fundamental support to AUD vs USD, but this is presented as a price-forecast/technical piece (relevance capped). Net AUD-positive near term.

FX.title: Indian Rupee retreats from its eight-month high against US Dollar
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) faces some correction against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday after a sharp rally in the past few weeks. The USD/INR pair rebounds to near 92.57 from its eight-month low of 92.18 posted the previous day.
FX.reason: USD/INR bounce signals USD strength/INR giveback after a sharp INR rally. This is an EMFX-local-currency weakening versus USD — moderate relevance for USD-centric FX flows.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar rebounds from 2009 low ahead of confidence data
FX.summary: Ten falling sessions in a row took NZD/USD to its lowest since March 2009 on Monday, and the two sessions since have recovered about a quarter of that run. It fell to near 0.5450 on Wednesday without reaching Monday's low and is trading just under 0.5500.
FX.reason: NZD/USD recovering from multi-year lows is a local FX rebound story; relevance is moderate (dominated by technical/positioning and near-term data risk).

Commodities.title: Gold rebounds above $3,550 as easing yields and weaker US Dollar counter hot US inflation data
Commodities.summary: Gold price (XAU/USD) recovers some lost ground to around $3,575 during the early Asian session on Thursday, supported by lower US Treasury yields and a weaker US Dollar (USD).
Commodities.reason: Direct gold price move supported by lower yields and weaker USD — clear positive for gold within the commodities universe. Strong macro drivers (yields, USD) increase relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold stays below $3,600 as Fed bets and USD uptick caps recovery from 15-month low
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) consolidates below the $3,600 mark through the Asian session on Thursday, stalling the previous day's solid bounce from its lowest level since August 2025.
Commodities.reason: Counter-signal: Fed rate expectations and USD strength capping gold gains. Important for near-term price action but primarily a short-term/market sentiment cap — lower relevance than macro directional drivers.

Commodities.title: WTI rises above $83.50 on Middle East refinery attack
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $83.65 during the early Asian trading hours on Thursday. WTI rises amid persistent threats to energy shipments in the Middle East.
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical attack on Middle East refinery raises supply-risk premium and lifts WTI. High relevance due to direct supply-risk transmission into oil prices.

Commodities.title: WTI Price Forecast: Eyes move beyond $84.00 as bulls retain control above 200-hour SMA
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – touches an over one-week high during the Asian session on Thursday, with bulls now awaiting a break above the $84.00 mark before placing fresh bets.
Commodities.reason: Technical/price-forecast piece for WTI. Signals near-term bullish momentum but is primarily technical analysis so relevance capped.

Commodities.title: Oil flows through Middle East chokepoints increased in the third quarter
Commodities.summary: Collective oil shipments through key chokepoints around the Middle East increased by 19% in the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26), according to our recently published Global Energy Security Data.
Commodities.reason: Higher flows through Middle East chokepoints point to improved physical availabilities / rerouting that can reduce risk premia — modestly negative for oil prices. EIA data gives this a meaningful relevance.

Commodities.title: Oil Holds Two-Day Gain as Mideast Tensions Fuel Market Jitters
Commodities.reason: Bloomberg note points to Mideast tensions as the dominant near-term driver keeping oil on the front foot. High relevance given market-wide impact and reaffirmation of a supply-risk narrative.

Commodities.title: Copper Rebounds From Lowest This Year as Volatility Grips Metals
Commodities.reason: Copper recovery from year-low signals improved risk sentiment for industrial metals and/or technical buying. Relevant for base metals allocation and reflects market volatility drivers.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD looks to build on recovery above $42.00
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) attracts some dip-buyers near the $40.85 area during the Asian session on Thursday, looking to build on the previous day's solid bounce from the $38.20 region, or its lowest level since August 2025.
Commodities.reason: Technical/near-term recovery signal for silver. Forecast/technical content limits relevance despite direct commodity focus.

Commodities.title: U.S. natural gas inventories end injection season above normal levels
Commodities.summary: Working natural gas in storage in the Lower 48 states ended the natural gas injection season at 3,810 billion cubic feet (Bcf), exceeding the five-year average by almost 2%, according to estimates based on data from our Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report releas
Commodities.reason: Inventories modestly above the five-year average is a supply-side bearish signal for natural gas fundamentals — directly relevant to gas prices.

Commodities.title: Gold's haven status has lost its edge over bitcoin, and the Fed's to blame
Commodities.reason: Narrative that investors are favoring bitcoin over gold points to reduced safe-haven demand for gold. Cross-asset commentary is relevant to gold flows but less directly actionable than primary commodity supply/demand data.

Crypto.title: A year after buying bitcoin, Czech central bank won't say what it's worth
Crypto.reason: Central bank ownership of bitcoin is a pro-adoption institutional signal for the asset class; limited valuation disclosure tempers the impact but overall supportive for crypto demand.

Crypto.title: Crypto traders can now hedge Nvidia, Anthropic and oil bets on Derive
Crypto.reason: Expansion of crypto-native derivatives to hedge cross-asset exposures increases on-chain utility, liquidity and institutional use-cases for crypto markets.

Crypto.title: Zcash developers want users to move $300 million out of an older privacy system
Crypto.reason: Protocol migration request is a proactive security/maintenance action; modestly positive for long-run network risk but involves short-term migration risk.

Crypto.title: Over 1,000 Bitcoin miners were tricked into working for a thief by a fake internet route
Crypto.reason: Large-scale BGP/internet-route hijack affecting miners is a material security event that undermines confidence in mining infrastructure and operational resilience.

Crypto.title: Bill to lock up U.S. government bitcoin for 20 years advances to full House
Crypto.reason: Major policy move that would remove supply from market for an extended period; strong positive demand/supply signal for bitcoin and the crypto asset class.

Crypto.title: 'This time actually seems different': Crypto veterans brace for more pain as bitcoin tumbles
Crypto.reason: Market-selloff narrative and veteran warnings point to elevated downside risk and worsening sentiment across crypto markets.

Crypto.title: Ukrainian lawmakers pass crypto tax and regulation bill expected to bring in $330 million
Crypto.reason: Clear regulatory and tax framework with revenue expectations supports onshore activity and legitimizes crypto business in a national jurisdiction.

Crypto.title: South Korean crypto exchange Bithumb warns of phishing after deeper October breach probe
Crypto.reason: Exchange security incidents and phishing risks reduce user confidence and trading flow into centralized platforms; negative for market trust.

Crypto.title: Ether, DeFi fall twice as hard as bitcoin as equities selloff resumes
Crypto.reason: Strong downside correlation with equities and outsized losses in ETH/DeFi highlight systemic risk, margin stress and liquidity withdrawal — large negative for the crypto complex.

Crypto.title: Anchorage Digital to unveil new asset-management subsidiary
Crypto.reason: Institutional product expansion by a major custodian/prime services firm supports institutional adoption and asset-management flows into crypto.

Crypto.title: South Korea proposes ending 2017 ICO ban to boost jobs and onshore crypto investment
Crypto.reason: Proposed regulatory easing to revive ICO activity would be a material pro-growth policy for crypto capital formation and onshore investment in a major market.

Crypto.title: Solana developers move to stop validators finishing work on blocks that already lost
Crypto.reason: Protocol-level change aimed at reducing wasted validator work modestly improves network efficiency and resilience for Solana.

Crypto.title: Italy’s UniCredit launches six-year bitcoin certificate with gains capped at 65%
Crypto.reason: Retail-structured product from a major bank expands access to bitcoin for European investors; positive but limited in scope.
